infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Convo to use your camera for video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Convo to use your microphone for calls and audio messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Convo to show the photos and videos you saved from your chats.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Convo to save photos and videos from your chats to your gallery.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Convo to record and send audio messages.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Convo to use your camera to shoot posts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Convo to use your microphone to record video with sound.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Convo to show the photos and videos you saved from your chats.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Convo to save photos and videos from your chats to your gallery.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Convo to find which of your contacts already use Convo, so you can add them as friends. Your contacts stay on your phone.
